_note: Maps detected speaker roles to ElevenLabs voice ids (agents/cast.py). One narrator + quoted speakers (a kid line gets the child voice, a father line the male voice) when lip-sync or voiceover is on. Values are ElevenLabs voice ids from your account; LEAVE EMPTY to fall back to the global default voice (ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID / the UI voice). The UI 'Cast voices' panel writes these per render; this file is the default. Explicit [voice: id] in the script still wins over everything.
